name: fabric-schedule-inventory
description: Microsoft Fabric app that inventories scheduled items across workspaces and shows them as a searchable table and a 24-hour Gantt timeline.
author: Kilian Baccaro Salinas

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && tsc -b

rayfinScriptBases.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
rayfinScriptBases.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
